policy_question: Can cases with static-inferred hard-negative reason be migrated if marked needs_review and not paper-facing approved?
conditions: Mark checker/hard-negative interpretation as needs_review; do not create paper-facing approval or metric claims
notes: Allows package creation while preserving review caveat.

policy_question: Can validation scripts be retained as legacy assets with standard output-policy caveat?
conditions: Scripts are retained assets only; do not run DB engines; do not imply validation success
notes: Separates package assets from execution evidence.

policy_question: Can Spark/local-path/raw plan artifacts be archive-mapped rather than copied?
conditions: Raw local-path artifacts must not be copied; sanitize or archive-map only
notes: Preserves traceability without publishing unsafe paths.

policy_question: Can missing retained evidence be represented as evidence_not_retained when core package assets are complete?
conditions: Require source/positive/checker/package core completeness; do not claim retained evidence exists
applies_to_cases: PERF_0002 and any matching future case
notes: Unlocks no-runs cases without inventing evidence.

policy_question: Is validation script execution required for package creation?
conditions: Scripts may be retained; execution requires separate authorization
notes: Avoids DB validation in package generation.

policy_question: Must package_validation_summary.json follow schema guard without task/global repo fields?
Must case README follow public template v1?
conditions: Use repository_spec/case_readme_public_template_v1.md and avoid forbidden process wording

policy_question: Can any wave002 case enter case_sets or denominators?
conditions: No case_sets or denominator changes in wave002

policy_question: Can raw logs prompt/token/API traces stdout/stderr/debug payloads be copied?
conditions: Do not copy raw logs, stdout/stderr/debug payloads, prompt/token/API/model traces, or local-path artifacts
